ages.titre: The Networks—Routes, Relays, Relays of Power

jalons.ordre: Memory and intention externalized into durable artifacts, creating transmissible knowledge independent of its bearer.
jalons.dette: Dependence on materials and know-how; a cognitive cost converted into a thermodynamic cost of extraction and shaping.

jalons.ordre: A secured social center, digestion externalized through cooking, useful hours extended by pushing back the night.
jalons.dette: A permanent energy debt owed to fuel; health costs (smoke); the first extractive gaze upon nature.

jalons.ordre: The invention of the long term, of collective memory, and of lineages; burial founds territory and legitimizes power.
jalons.dette: The colossal material and energy cost of funerary rites; space taken from the living; social inequalities petrified beyond death.

jalons.ordre: Large-scale social coordination, transmission of complex knowledge, the capacity for abstract thought (past, future, hypotheses).
jalons.dette: The upkeep cost of conventions (grammar); confinement within categories of thought; exclusion through the word (taboos).

jalons.ordre: A high-frequency interface of social recognition, accelerating coordination and establishing nonverbal protocols of trust.
jalons.dette: The metabolic cost of processing facial information; future infrastructures of control (biometrics) built on the surveillance of faces.

jalons.ordre: Long-distance exchange networks based on conventions of value (ornaments, pigments), reducing uncertainty.
jalons.dette: Inequalities formalized through the accumulation of symbolic goods; the cost of logistics; division between those who share the code and everyone else.

jalons.ordre: Social cohesion beyond kinship through the ritualized management of anxiety and a shared sacred calendar.
jalons.dette: The material cost of offerings and places of worship; time taken from subsistence; division between initiates and those excluded from the rite.

jalons.ordre: A durable symbolic external memory that fixes complex narratives and lets consciousness reflect upon itself.
jalons.dette: The energy and physical cost of producing the works in remote places (pigments, lighting, danger); representational codes fixed in ways that frame how the world is perceived.

jalons.ordre: Food security through surplus, sedentarization, population explosion.
jalons.dette: Bondage to land and labor; social hierarchies founded on storage; an agricultural debt owed to soils and climate.

jalons.ordre: Logistical efficiency, hauling set free, standardized production (the potter’s wheel).
jalons.dette: The obligation to build and maintain infrastructure (roads); confinement within mechanical logic and its upkeep costs.

jalons.ordre: Specialization of tasks, centralized management of surpluses, safety through urban concentration.
jalons.dette: Rigid social stratification; loss of individual autonomy; heightened fragility in the face of epidemics and centralized famines.

jalons.ordre: An infallible administrative memory, written law, State accounting that guarantees contracts.
jalons.dette: The creation of a scribal caste; exclusion of the illiterate; social norms rigidified and flexibility lost.

jalons.ordre: Divine legitimation of temporal power, the empire synchronized by a shared ritual calendar.
jalons.dette: The colossal material cost of temples and sacrifices; politics subordinated to theology; the logistical debt of offerings.

jalons.ordre: Acceleration and efficiency in decision-making by short-circuiting deliberation.
jalons.dette: Loss of collective legitimacy; risk concentrated on a single head; structural instability; a debt of time levied on citizens.

jalons.titre: Zhou—Mandate of Heaven, order of the world
jalons.ordre: A contract of conditional legitimacy (the “Mandate of Heaven”), binding power to visible performance (prosperity, order).
jalons.dette: Governance through anxiety (the fear of losing the mandate); the cost of rituals and inspections to prove virtue; a permanent performance debt.

jalons.titre: Olympia—war played so it need not be waged
jalons.ordre: Conflict sublimated into regulated competition; a sacred truce allowing Panhellenic circulation.
jalons.dette: The cost of infrastructure and ritual sacrifices; structural exclusion (women, “barbarians”); a physical debt levied on athletes’ bodies.

jalons.ordre: Internal civic peace guaranteed by a sacred boundary (the pomerium) that defines an inside and an outside.
jalons.dette: Violence permanently externalized outward (conquest) or returning periodically within (civil wars), reenacting the founding murder.

jalons.titre: Coinage—trust struck with the seal of doubt
jalons.ordre: Portable, anonymous trust, easing long-distance exchange by compressing the ritual of weighing.
jalons.dette: The cost of the guarantee (mining, policing counterfeits); value abstracted, enabling financial crises and a devaluation of trust.

jalons.ordre: A protocol for release from suffering through “non-clinging” to desires; mental order and inner discipline.
jalons.dette: Material support of the monastic community (saṃgha) by the laity; a debt of time and resources (alms, upkeep) to finance the monks’ inner peace.

jalons.ordre: A social order founded on the exemplarity of gestures (li) and roles, spreading by imitation rather than by decree.
jalons.dette: The cost in time and attention of learning and maintaining the rites; the “models” financed by the community; the risk of rigidifying into conformism.

jalons.ordre: A public space for staging and metabolizing insoluble conflicts (law versus family, State versus individual).
jalons.dette: The material and financial cost of performances (the choregia); civic time taken from production to allow collective catharsis.

jalons.titre: Democracy—the power of all, the fear of each
jalons.ordre: Power shared among citizens through common law (isonomia), sortition, and public deliberation.
jalons.dette: Structural exclusion of women, metics, and slaves; citizenship financed by empire (tribute) and servile labor (the Laurion mines).

jalons.titre: Pythagoras—the mathematical dream of an ordered world
jalons.ordre: An intelligible cosmos, governed by numerical ratios and mathematical harmonies.
jalons.dette: Exclusion of the incommensurable (the irrational); the material cost of abstraction (schools, instruments, freed time); the risk of a tyranny of the norm.

jalons.titre: Heraclitus and Parmenides—the river against the sphere
jalons.ordre: Two founding visions of Western metaphysics: the world as permanent flux (Heraclitus) or as eternal, unchanging being (Parmenides).
jalons.dette: The material cost of thought (time, schools, scribes); a cognitive debt for later generations, forced to navigate this conceptual tension.

jalons.titre: Sun Tzu—the art of fighting without fighting
jalons.ordre: Victory through strategic configuration and the manipulation of information, avoiding direct confrontation.
jalons.dette: Peace without trust; mistrust and manipulation generalized as a mode of relation; the cost of intelligence and espionage.

jalons.titre: Thermopylae/Salamis—the West invents itself by inventing the East
jalons.ordre: A founding narrative of a “Western” identity (free, measured) set against a caricatured “East” (servile, excessive).
jalons.dette: Athenian naval democracy financed by slavery (the Laurion mines); a debt of symbolic violence toward the Persians.

jalons.ordre: A physics of motion made possible by introducing the void as an operative principle, explaining change as the rearrangement of atoms.
jalons.dette: The social cost of materialist thought (accusations of impiety); the material debt of philosophical schools (time, patronage).

jalons.ordre: Absolute strategic effectiveness through a liquid intelligence, able to adapt to every system in order to manipulate it from within.
jalons.dette: Trust and loyalty dissolved; one side’s tactical gains are paid for in systemic disorder for all the others (prolonged wars, broken alliances).

jalons.titre: Sophocles—the law of the heart against the heart of the law
jalons.ordre: A theatrical space for staging the irreducible tension between the impersonal norm of the city and the unwritten law of conscience and family.
jalons.dette: The material cost of performance (the choregia); civic time immobilized to allow collective catharsis, paid for by those excluded from citizenship.

jalons.ordre: Rhetorical skill democratized, turning speech into a purchasable technique rather than a privilege of birth.
jalons.dette: Social trust devalued as truth becomes a commodity; institutional costs (a proliferation of lawsuits) and cognitive costs (generalized skepticism).

jalons.titre: Thucydides—repeating so as not to begin again
jalons.ordre: An operative memory of history, founded on the search for causes and the logic of power relations, to defuse the future.
jalons.dette: The material cost of the inquiry (financed by his mines); the moral debt of a knowledge that, by exposing the brutality of the real (“the strong do what they can”), can inject a lasting chill.

jalons.titre: Callicles—the right of the strongest, the law of the weak
jalons.ordre: A “natural” legitimation of domination and of the maximization of desires (pleonexia) by an elite.
jalons.dette: The burden of moderation and cooperation is shifted onto the “weak”; the order of the strong is financed by the exhaustion and servitude of everyone else.

jalons.ordre: Inner peace (ataraxia) through the limitation of desires and the elimination of fears (of the gods, of death).
jalons.dette: The Epicurean community’s “live hidden” is subsidized by the order and labor of the city it flees; a debt of civic participation.

jalons.ordre: Civic hygiene through the systematic testing of apparent knowledge; coherence becomes the criterion of just discourse.
jalons.dette: Constant social friction, a cost in time for the city; the ultimate debt is paid with his own life to preserve the integrity of the law.

jalons.titre: Plato—building the ideal, inhabiting the impossible
jalons.ordre: An architecture of knowledge and of the just city, founded on ideal forms that serve as the standard for judging the real.
jalons.dette: The cost of training the “guardians” is borne by the producing class; the ideal order demands censorship, the “noble lie,” and the banishment of the poets.

jalons.ordre: A universal system of classification (categories, causes) that makes the world intelligible and governable through measure and prudence (phronesis).
jalons.dette: Classificatory knowledge, once it becomes a norm, excludes and pathologizes “deviations”; measure becomes an instrument of normalization.

jalons.ordre: An immense space unified by the speed of conquest, creating the first “Hellenistic” cultural space.
jalons.dette: Persian political and administrative orders destroyed; the human and logistical cost of the military campaign; a debt of legitimacy owed to his own troops.

jalons.ordre: Absolute individual sovereignty through radical renunciation and the refusal of conventions.
jalons.dette: His freedom is subsidized by the surplus and tolerance of the city he despises (alms, safety); a debt of participation in the common burdens.

jalons.ordre: A universal regime of proof in which authority is earned by demonstration, accessible to all regardless of social status.
jalons.dette: The formal equality of access to proof masks a real inequality of access to the time and education needed to master it.

jalons.titre: Archimedes—a fixed point for a moving world
jalons.ordre: Mechanical mastery of the world through the application of principles (the lever, buoyancy) that multiply human force.
jalons.dette: The material and human cost of the machines (wood, metal, workshops) and of their financing by a political power (King Hiero II).

jalons.titre: Qin—the empire forged in totalitarian uniformity
jalons.ordre: Imperial unity through radical standardization (writing, currency, measures, axle widths).
jalons.dette: Local cultures and knowledge destroyed (the “burning of the books”); the colossal human cost of the great public works (wall, canals); State violence as a principle of government.

jalons.titre: The Rubicon—when speed assassinates the law
jalons.ordre: An end to civil war through a lightning seizure of power, where the speed of the fait accompli replaces deliberation.
jalons.dette: Republican legality assassinated; the human and economic cost of the military campaigns; a debt of legitimacy settled by dictatorship.

jalons.ordre: A community founded on the inversion of values (poverty, forgiveness), undermining the Empire’s logic of power from within.
jalons.dette: The cost of martyrdom, the State’s violence being absorbed by the bodies of believers; an organizational debt for the communities (mutual aid, alms).

jalons.ordre: Administration made fluid, creating a “liquid State” able to remember, circulate, and revise itself at low cost.
jalons.dette: The ecological cost of production (water, fibers); an explosion of bureaucracy; increased surveillance; a debt of time for scribes and administrators.

jalons.titre: Juvenal—feeding the belly, starving the mind
jalons.ordre: Social peace through the distribution of food (panem) and entertainment (circenses), occupying the people’s bodies and attention.
jalons.dette: Citizenship atrophied into a passive clientele; the colossal logistical and financial cost of maintaining the grain flows and the games.

jalons.ordre: An impregnable inner citadel, freedom through the mastery of judgments and the discipline of desire.
jalons.dette: The social cost of indifference to common burdens; the otium (free time) this asceticism requires is financed by the labor of others (slaves, servants).

jalons.titre: Constantine—saving the empire by killing its gods
jalons.ordre: The empire unified under a single symbol (the cross), creating a new infrastructure of loyalty.
jalons.dette: Pagan orders and economies destroyed (temples, priesthoods); the cost of building the new ecclesiastical apparatus; conflict displaced onto heresies.

jalons.ordre: Warrior force transmuted into durable divine legitimacy; the anointing institutes an immortal political body that outlives the king’s physical body.
jalons.dette: The cost of the ecclesiastical apparatus (endowments, basilicas, tax exemptions) shifted onto public finances and lay landowners.

jalons.ordre: A stable, productive framework for living (ora et labora) that transforms time through the discipline of the Rule, releasing spiritual and material energy.
jalons.dette: Material support of the monastery through gifts, rents, and the labor of dependent laypeople (familia); an ecological debt on the lands worked (hides for parchment).

jalons.ordre: A unified social and spiritual protocol (prayers, zakāt) that synchronizes a decentralized network of believers and creates a community (the Umma).
jalons.dette: The cost of establishing a consensus (standardization under ʿUthmān), which displaces conflict into politics (schisms); the cost of conformity for society (time, resources).

jalons.ordre: Traditional military hierarchies leveled (“ballistic democracy”); the chemical recipe prevails over birth.
jalons.dette: Death industrialized, the ecological cost of production (saltpeter, charcoal); regulating violence becomes more costly and more centralized.

jalons.ordre: Greek philosophy and science transmitted and enriched, creating a conceptual infrastructure for Europe’s intellectual future.
jalons.dette: The material cost of translation and copying (paper, scribes, libraries) financed by Islamic powers; the West would inherit the knowledge while often erasing the ferryman’s signature.

jalons.ordre: A violent conquest transformed into a centralized administrative State (the Domesday Book) and a durable legal order (common law).
jalons.dette: Massive expropriation of the Anglo-Saxon elite; the human cost of repression (the Harrying of the North); symbolic violence through the imposition of Norman language and law.

jalons.ordre: An infrastructure of “cognitive compatibility” that makes Greek, Arabic, and Jewish knowledge interoperable and available to the Latin West.
jalons.dette: The material cost of the translation workshop (patronage, parchment, wages); the transformation of concepts imports frameworks of thought that lastingly reconfigure Latin culture.

jalons.titre: The University of Paris—the forge of disputes
jalons.ordre: Truth produced through regulated confrontation (the disputatio), creating an autonomous intellectual authority set against political and religious power.
jalons.dette: The social cost of maintaining an unproductive student population; a material debt (colleges, books); exclusion of those who do not master the scholastic code.

jalons.ordre: Doctrinal unity of Christendom through the eradication of the Cathar heresy; the invention of the Inquisition as a procedure for controlling consciences.
jalons.dette: Physical and symbolic violence (massacres, pyres); a cultural ecosystem destroyed (the langue d’oc); the moral debt of an orthodoxy imposed by terror.

jalons.ordre: Royal power limited by a written contract, establishing the predictability of law (due process) and a right of resistance.
jalons.dette: The cost of a permanent judicial apparatus; procedural friction as a new form of conflict; internal peace sometimes paid for with violence exported to the margins.

jalons.ordre: An intellectual synthesis that makes Aristotelian reason and Christian faith compatible, creating a durable architecture of knowledge.
jalons.dette: Institutional costs (university quarrels); conflict displaced onto technical points that would feed future schisms; clarity paid for in conceptual exclusions.

jalons.ordre: A poetic jurisdiction above the political, judging History and assigning each person their place within a moral cosmology.
jalons.dette: A national language standardized (Tuscan) at the expense of the dialects; the material debt of producing and circulating the work (patronage, copyists).

jalons.ordre: A transnational financial network in which religious trust guarantees the circulation of value without transporting metal (bills of exchange).
jalons.dette: The centralization of financial information by an autonomous order becomes a threat to the State, which destroys it and appropriates its technology of control.

jalons.ordre: A major intellectual hub founded on a knowledge economy (a book worth more than gold) and distributed resilience (private libraries).
jalons.dette: The high cost of importing the raw material (paper); preservation in a hostile environment demands constant engineering and investment.

jalons.ordre: A cyclical model of history that makes the rise and fall of dynasties intelligible through the force of social cohesion (’asabiyya).
jalons.dette: Lucidity about the mechanics of power can lead to cynicism or paralysis; the cycle itself is a debt of blood and resources paid at every transition.

jalons.ordre: The French monarchy re-legitimized by a charismatic short-circuit that transcends institutional mediations (Church, nobility).
jalons.dette: The financial and military cost of the campaigns; institutional disorder for the established powers; the ultimate debt paid with her own life at the stake.

jalons.titre: Alberti—framing the world, building the eye
jalons.ordre: A rationalized visual space, measurable and reproducible through perspective, turning painting into a “window onto the world.”
jalons.dette: The eye is bound to a single, immobile point of view; the frame excludes what lies outside it; mastery of the visible is paid for with the loss of peripheral, multisensory vision.

jalons.ordre: Planetary unification, the creation of a Euro-centered world-system through cartography, accounting, and military power.
jalons.dette: Amerindian civilizations destroyed, the slave trade, resources plundered; a bottomless human, ecological, and moral debt.

jalons.ordre: Transparency and trust in commercial exchange through double-entry bookkeeping, which makes wealth relational and verifiable.
jalons.dette: Lives and non-monetary costs rendered invisible in the balance sheets; the accounting form can mask inequality and fraud; clarity has a bureaucratic cost.

jalons.titre: Machiavelli—the virtue of vice, the morality of force
jalons.ordre: Stability and permanence of the State through a technology of decision (virtù) that judges acts by their public consequences, not their private morality.
jalons.dette: The moral debt of cruelty turned into an instrument of government; the human and economic cost of “necessities” paid by civilian populations.

jalons.ordre: A textual truth restored (the New Testament) through philological method (ad fontes), founding modern criticism.
jalons.dette: Questioning the Vulgate cracks the Church’s authority, supplying the intellectual tools of the Reformation and of the wars of religion that follow.

jalons.ordre: Access to salvation decentralized (sola fide, sola scriptura), the individual conscience becoming the validator of faith, without an ecclesial intermediary.
jalons.dette: Christendom fragmented, wars of religion; the cost of confessional order is paid in armed conflict and lasting political divisions.

jalons.titre: Copernicus—decentering the sky, reframing the earth
jalons.ordre: Geometric and predictive coherence of the universe by placing the Sun at the center, founding a new celestial physics.
jalons.dette: Theological and social disorder as man is unseated from his central place; the institutional cost of conflicts with the Church (Galileo’s trial).

jalons.titre: La Boétie—the people as their own tyrant
jalons.ordre: Servitude diagnosed as the product of active consent, founding the possibility of liberation through the simple refusal to serve.
jalons.dette: The text shifts responsibility for tyranny from the tyrant to the people themselves, creating a debt of lucidity and civic courage.

jalons.titre: The East India companies—the invention of the world-company
jalons.ordre: A planetary commercial network, financed by liquid, anonymous capital (shares), endowed with sovereign prerogatives (to fit out fleets, to negotiate).
jalons.dette: Structural violence (the Banda massacre), forced monocultures, founding ecocides, and risks externalized onto colonized populations.

jalons.titre: Galileo—bringing down the sky to raise the mind
jalons.ordre: A technology of objectivity in which proof is produced by the instrument (the telescope) and becomes reproducible and verifiable by all.
jalons.dette: Disorder transferred from cosmology to the ecclesiastical institution, provoking conflicts of authority and trials (the condemnation of 1633).

jalons.ordre: A common law among nations, founded on natural reason, which frames war (jus ad bellum, jus in bello) and makes it procedural.
jalons.dette: Once “civilized,” war becomes governable and therefore lasting; the legal order legitimizes violence under conditions, at the expense of the civilian populations who pay its cost.

jalons.ordre: An audit protocol for thought (the Discourse on Method) that grounds certainty in individual self-evidence (the cogito) rather than external authority.
jalons.dette: A fracture between soul and body (res cogitans/res extensa), relegating the sensible; an ontological and medical debt that would treat the body as a machine.

jalons.titre: Westphalia—the art of coexisting by ignoring one another
jalons.ordre: Peace through separation; territorial sovereignty and noninterference become the principles of an international order founded on the balance of power.
jalons.dette: European peace is paid for by freezing the aspirations of peoples and by making “domestic tyrannies” untouchable within borders.

jalons.titre: Hobbes—the monster that saves us from ourselves
jalons.ordre: Absolute security through the total alienation of individual liberties to an artificial sovereign (the Leviathan) who ends the “war of all against all.”
jalons.dette: Fear becomes the foundation of politics; the question “who protects us from the protector?” remains unanswered, opening the way to totalitarianism.

jalons.ordre: The fiscal-military State, a centralized machine that rationalizes taxation (Colbert) and force (Louvois) to maximize the kingdom’s power.
jalons.dette: Crushing fiscal pressure on the people; the State’s glory is financed by the organized misery of the countryside and by perpetual wars.

jalons.titre: Newton—the apple that would kill God
jalons.ordre: A universe unified by universal mathematical laws (gravitation), making the cosmos predictable and calculable.
jalons.dette: The clockwork world no longer needs the divine hypothesis in order to run; disorder is displaced from physics into metaphysics (the disenchantment of the world).

jalons.titre: Locke—obeying in order to be free
jalons.ordre: Legitimate government founded on consent and the guarantee of natural rights (life, liberty, property), with a right of resistance built in.
jalons.dette: Political liberty in the metropole is financed by economic servitude in the colonies (slavery, expropriation of lands).

jalons.ordre: Political liberty through the separation of powers (legislative, executive, judicial), where “power checks power.”
jalons.dette: Liberty is paid for with a “calculated inefficiency”; institutional friction and procedural slowness become the cost of protection against the arbitrary.

jalons.ordre: Skeptical lucidity in revealing that causality is not a law of the world but a habit of our minds.
jalons.dette: The order of certainties collapses, replaced by an order of probabilities that demands a constant cost of verification, replication, and the upkeep of doubt.

jalons.titre: Voltaire—nothing is so certain as doubt
jalons.ordre: A critical public sphere in which opinion, armed with reason and publicity (the Calas affair), can judge and correct the abuses of power.
jalons.dette: By undermining traditional authorities without building replacement institutions, critique releases forces that reason alone cannot contain, risking demagoguery.

jalons.titre: The Physiocrats—the blood and sap of wealth
jalons.ordre: The first macroeconomic model (the Tableau économique), seeing the economy as an organism whose wealth springs from the land.
jalons.dette: The liberalized order of flows (free circulation of grain) displaces disorder onto prices, provoking food riots (the “Flour War”).

jalons.ordre: Knowledge democratized and unified through alphabetical order and critical cross-references, making the secrets of power and of the trades transparent.
jalons.dette: An abundance of information without hierarchy displaces disorder onto interpretation; the critique of authority can lead to its dissolution and to instability.

jalons.titre: Rousseau—the fire beneath the democratic ash
jalons.ordre: Legitimacy founded on the “general will”; civil liberty consists in obeying the law one has given oneself.
jalons.dette: The order of the common is paid for in constraints on the individual (taxation, military service); brandished as an absolute, the general will can justify the Terror.

jalons.ordre: Risk mutualized, transforming an uncertain future into calculable probabilities and payable premiums.
jalons.dette: New exclusions created (the “uninsurable”); the moral debt of surveillance (moral hazard); the socialization of risk can lead to its privatization (bank bailouts).

jalons.titre: Adam Smith—the invisible hand, a blind guide
jalons.ordre: Selfish interests coordinated by the anonymous mechanism of the market, producing wealth through the division of labor.
jalons.dette: The stultification and alienation of the specialized worker; social and ecological costs externalized, unaccounted for in the price.

jalons.ordre: A republic founded on the “pursuit of happiness,” where economic success becomes a sign of election and a civic duty.
jalons.dette: Profit is sanctified at the price of slavery, the expropriation of indigenous peoples, and the creation of a structural social and racial debt.

jalons.titre: Kant—the clockmaker of Königsberg takes History apart
jalons.ordre: A philosophy of history in which men’s “unsocial sociability” drives them, unknowingly, toward perpetual peace through law.
jalons.dette: Progress is paid for by the conflict and suffering of present generations; the future order is financed by present disorder and violence.

jalons.titre: Revolution—the theater that devours its actors
jalons.ordre: National sovereignty, civil equality proclaimed, and the invention of politics-as-spectacle in which the people become a public actor.
jalons.dette: Chronic institutional instability; the Terror and civil wars as the cost of refounding; violence becomes the arbiter of political debate.

jalons.titre: The Rights of Man—transcendence without God
jalons.ordre: Universal principles (liberty, equality) becoming a norm above the State, founding a right of resistance.
jalons.dette: Abstract universality masks de facto exclusions (women, slaves, the colonized); the ideal becomes a tool of justification for new forms of domination.

jalons.ordre: An “equal,” rationalized standardization of capital punishment, turning public torture into administrative procedure.
jalons.dette: The technical possibility of industrialized death; the executioner’s responsibility dissolved into that of an operator; State murder made banal.

jalons.ordre: The first Black republic born of a victorious slave revolt, giving the Rights of Man concrete universality.
jalons.dette: A crushing indemnity paid to the former colonists; diplomatic isolation and the country’s lasting economic strangulation by the slaveholding powers.

jalons.ordre: The demand that the universal be extended to women, exposing the contradiction of an exclusively male liberty.
jalons.dette: Violent repression; women lastingly erased from the political sphere by law (the Civil Code) and by custom.

jalons.titre: Romantic love—the heart as a code of exclusion
jalons.ordre: Individual choice and intimacy legitimized as the foundation of the couple, against the socially arranged match.
jalons.dette: Gender roles naturalized; the mental and domestic load (borne mostly by women) rendered invisible; affects commodified.

jalons.ordre: Social cohesion and a capacity for mass mobilization (conscription, taxation) founded on an imagined common belonging.
jalons.dette: Exclusion and suspicion toward minorities and the foreigner (xenophobia); borders sacralized, leading to total wars.

jalons.titre: The Terror—the machine for purifying souls
jalons.ordre: Radical centralization of power and revolutionary discipline to save the Republic from internal and external threats.
jalons.dette: Institutionalized paranoia, purges, and mass executions; virtue becomes a pretext for the physical elimination of opponents.

jalons.ordre: Law unified, contracts and property secured, founding the predictability of the bourgeois economy.
jalons.dette: Patriarchy institutionalized (the married woman’s civil incapacity) along with unequal filiation; social statuses rigidified.

jalons.titre: Vienna—the ball of the enlightened cynics
jalons.ordre: A century of geopolitical stability in Europe (the “Concert of Europe”) through a negotiated balance of power.
jalons.dette: The national and liberal aspirations of peoples smothered; repression legitimized in the name of dynastic order.

jalons.titre: Thermodynamics—the entropy of the terminal program
jalons.ordre: Universal laws of energy allowing an unprecedented optimization of machines and industry.
jalons.dette: Awareness of energy’s inescapable degradation (entropy); the end of the illusion of perpetual progress; an ecological debt through massive combustion.

jalons.titre: The abolition of slavery—the human being proclaimed
jalons.ordre: Legal recognition of human personhood for millions of individuals, the end of “chattel” status.
jalons.dette: Compensation paid to slave owners (not to the victims); the persistence of structural racism and of disguised regimes of forced labor.

jalons.titre: Tocqueville—the aristocratic prophet of our servitudes
jalons.ordre: A lucid diagnosis of democracy, of its strengths (equality) and its risks (tyranny of the majority, soft despotism).
jalons.dette: The critique of conformity can itself become a posture of intellectual distinction; a risk of paralysis through hyper-awareness of the perils.

jalons.ordre: Instant long-distance communication, the synchronization of markets, empires, and clocks.
jalons.dette: The tyranny of urgency, the loss of depth and time for reflection; the systemic vulnerability of centralized networks; an infrastructure debt.

jalons.titre: The Spring of 1848—the simultaneous failure of the peoples
jalons.ordre: Continental diffusion of democratic, national, and social ideas; an apprenticeship in political mobilization.
jalons.dette: Coordinated repression by the empires; a lasting fracture between liberals and socialists; failure immunizes the elites and delays reform.

jalons.ordre: Fluid circulation, public hygiene (sewers, ventilation), imperial monumentality.
jalons.dette: Social segregation through the expulsion of the working classes to the outskirts; the old social fabric destroyed; a colossal financial debt.

jalons.titre: Hygienism—the body under a public-health contract
jalons.ordre: Public health, a spectacular drop in mortality through hygiene norms (water, vaccines).
jalons.dette: Biopolitics: social and normative control of bodies; stigmatization of the classes deemed “dangerous”; an immune debt (the hygiene hypothesis).

jalons.ordre: A unified, materialist explanation of the diversity of life through natural selection.
jalons.dette: The end of divine design and of man’s central place; the theory instrumentalized as “social Darwinism” to justify inequalities and imperialism.

jalons.ordre: Long-term capital accumulation through legal personhood and limited liability.
jalons.dette: Systemic externalization of costs (social, ecological); organized irresponsibility; economic power without a democratic counterweight.

jalons.ordre: A critical grammar of capitalism, unveiling the mechanism of exploitation (surplus value); an organizing tool for the workers’ movement.
jalons.dette: A risk of dogmatism and economic reductionism in certain readings; an ideological polarization that can freeze analysis.

jalons.titre: Meiji—becoming the other to remain oneself
jalons.ordre: Accelerated modernization, a powerful central State, national sovereignty preserved in the face of the West.
jalons.dette: Authoritarianism, militarism, and imperial expansionism; traditional social structures destroyed (the samurai); the human cost of forced industrialization.

jalons.titre: The Commune—the revolution that invents its own vocabulary
jalons.ordre: An experiment in direct democratic self-government (recallable mandates, self-management).
jalons.dette: Civil war and extreme repression (the “Bloody Week”); the memory of the crushing would long weigh on France’s social movements.

jalons.titre: Ferry’s schools—the machine for formatting souls
jalons.ordre: National unity through compulsory schooling, secularism, and a common language.
jalons.dette: Regional cultures eradicated by the imposition of a “single canon”; the formatting of a schoolroom nationalism that prepared the slaughter of 1914–18 and legitimized the “coloniality of knowledge.”

jalons.ordre: The night pushed back, a planetary nervous system created, time and activities synchronized.
jalons.dette: A debt owed to nature (extraction, pollution), to future generations (maintenance, waste), and to physics (systemic losses).

jalons.titre: Berlin—the world carved up with a ruler
jalons.ordre: Geopolitical stability in Europe through the regulated partition of Africa; colonial spheres of influence sanctuarized.
jalons.dette: Artificial borders created (a “homicidal geometry”) that divide some peoples and confine others, programming future conflicts on the African continent.

jalons.ordre: Lucidity through the “revaluation of all values”; the diagnosis of the “death of God” and of the morality of ressentiment.
jalons.dette: A metaphysical void filled by substitute absolutes (Nation, Race, Class); “guilt” (Schuld) is displaced from theology into politics and economics.

jalons.titre: The Dreyfus Affair—the Republic before its shattered mirror
jalons.ordre: The rule of law reaffirmed against reason of State; the invention of the engaged intellectual; a clarification of the political landscape.
jalons.dette: A deep fracture in French society; a militant antisemitism and nationalism legitimized and organized.

jalons.ordre: The psyche made intelligible through the mapping of the unconscious; a therapeutic method (the talking cure) that gives symptoms a meaning.
jalons.dette: The order of a defense (the symptom) displaces the disorder of a drive; consciousness is dispossessed of its mastery; a psychic debt managed but never canceled.

jalons.titre: The separation of Church and State—the eldest daughter emancipates herself
jalons.ordre: State neutrality, civil peace through the privatization of faith, freedom of conscience and worship guaranteed.
jalons.dette: A secular debt: the State becomes guarantor and arbiter of the coexistence of faiths, with permanent costs of upkeep (church buildings) and regulation (procedures).

jalons.ordre: Space, time, matter, and energy unified under invariant physical laws.
jalons.dette: A nuclear debt (E=mc²); the cognitive debt of a counterintuitive world; the cost of the infrastructures needed to verify and use his theories (GPS, accelerators).

jalons.titre: Total war—the machine for grinding down the human
jalons.ordre: Society mobilized in full (factories, capital, minds) for maximum military efficiency.
jalons.dette: A human debt (millions dead), a psychic one (shell shock), an ecological one (the red zones), and a political one (treaties that program the next war).

jalons.titre: The October Revolution—paradise gives birth to the Gulag
jalons.ordre: A socialist order imposed by a vanguard party, the economy and the State centralized.
jalons.dette: The human cost of terror, organized famines, and the Gulag; the promise of equality is paid for in generalized servitude and shortages.

jalons.ordre: The engineering of public opinion, making the masses governable and desires predictable for the market.
jalons.dette: A cognitive debt (the impoverishment of debate), a democratic debt (the citizen’s alienation), and a social debt (needs artificially created).

jalons.ordre: A probabilistic description of fundamental reality that allows unprecedented technical mastery (transistors, lasers).
jalons.dette: The end of classical determinism; a permanent debt of philosophical interpretation; the energy cost of the infrastructures for mastering the infinitely small.

jalons.titre: Penicillin—the body under an algorithmic contract
jalons.ordre: An administered victory over bacterial infections, a drastic drop in mortality, surgical safety.
jalons.dette: The biological debt of antibiotic resistance; disorder displaced onto chronic diseases; a debt of surveillance (biopolitics).

jalons.titre: The Popular Front—taking the symbols, conceding the essential
jalons.ordre: Major social rights won (paid vacations, the 40-hour week), workers’ dignity recognized.
jalons.dette: Economic disorder (inflation, capital flight); the moral debt of nonintervention in Spain.

jalons.titre: Culture industry vs. public broadcasting—the war of narratives
jalons.ordre: Cultural formats standardized for industry, a common civic space created by public broadcasting.
jalons.dette: The culture industry displaces disorder into minds (conformism, passivity); public broadcasting displaces it into politics (pressures, elitism).

jalons.ordre: An immediate and illusory peace through concession in the face of force.
jalons.dette: War deferred and amplified; the cost is displaced onto the sacrificed nation (Czechoslovakia) and future generations.

jalons.titre: June 18—the Word that founds a phantom State
jalons.ordre: The continuity of French legitimacy through the force of a speech act, creating a State without territory.
jalons.dette: The cost of this symbolic order is paid in lives by the Resistance and the Free French, and in the destruction endured for the Liberation.

jalons.titre: Churchill—the orator who spoke his empire to death
jalons.ordre: National cohesion in the face of imminent defeat, speech transformed into a strategic weapon.
jalons.dette: The war effort is paid for by the liquidation of the British Empire and a colossal financial debt to the United States.

jalons.ordre: The war’s accelerated end, the establishment of an order of nuclear deterrence (“peace” through terror).
jalons.dette: A human and ecological debt on the destroyed cities; the moral and psychic debt of a humanity capable of annihilating itself.

jalons.ordre: Compulsory solidarity that mutualizes life’s risks (illness, old age) and decommodifies care.
jalons.dette: An intergenerational debt (workers paying for retirees) and a financial debt (deficits) managed by a bureaucratic apparatus.

jalons.ordre: Moral and political legitimation of the creation of Israel through the staging of the suffering of Shoah survivors.
jalons.dette: Disorder transferred onto the Palestinian people (the Nakba); the competition of memories entrenches an insoluble conflict of identities.

jalons.ordre: A universal moral norm that makes the violation of human rights visible and illegitimate.
jalons.dette: The text creates a permanent “compliance debt” for all States; disorder is displaced from brute force into justification and procedure.

jalons.titre: Shannon—killing meaning, giving birth to information
jalons.ordre: A mathematical theory of communication that allows error-free data transmission and founds the digital era.
jalons.dette: Meaning is evacuated from the process; syntactic order is paid for with semantic disorder (information overload, loss of context).

jalons.ordre: The genetic code understood, opening the way to the engineering of life.
jalons.dette: An ethical debt (eugenics 2.0), an ecological one (GMOs), and a social one (biological inequalities); genetic precision creates normative chaos.

jalons.titre: The Common Market—the union that divides
jalons.ordre: Peace through economic integration, the creation of a unified market.
jalons.dette: Political conflict displaced into technocratic norms; popular sovereignty eroded in favor of governance at a distance.

jalons.ordre: Executive stability through the concentration of presidential power.
jalons.dette: Parliament and intermediate bodies weakened; democratic disorder displaced into abstention or the street.

jalons.ordre: An ever more precise body of scientific evidence on global warming.
jalons.dette: Exact knowledge becomes an alibi for political inaction; the carbon debt accumulates, transferring physical chaos onto future generations.

jalons.ordre: An order of flags and national anthems, formal political independence.
jalons.dette: Structures of economic and political dependence persist (neo-colonialism); the arbitrariness of borders displaces disorder within the new States.

jalons.ordre: Individual mastery of the fertility calendar, sexuality dissociated from reproduction.
jalons.dette: The contraceptive load (health-related, mental) is overwhelmingly shifted onto women; a debt of research into male contraception.

jalons.ordre: A multiplication of sovereign nation-states.
jalons.dette: Former metropoles and new States alike face crises of identity; the colonial repressed returns, mirrored (immigration, racism, civil wars).

jalons.ordre: The diagnosis of a society in which social relations are mediated by images.
jalons.dette: The spectacle colonizes the imaginary and lived life; the order of consumption displaces disorder into alienation and passivity.

jalons.titre: May ’68—pleasure without shackles, shackles without pleasure
jalons.ordre: A liberation of mores and a radical critique of authority.
jalons.dette: The refusal of political power lets capitalism co-opt the critique and turn it into a marketing argument; cultural freedom is paid for with economic precarity.

jalons.ordre: A supreme technical and symbolic feat, a demonstration of human power.
jalons.dette: A colossal financial cost that displaces earthly priorities (the social, poverty); the ecological debt of the space race (debris).

jalons.ordre: Universal, miniaturized computing power, founding automation and the information society.
jalons.dette: An ecological debt (electronic waste), a social one (obsolete trades), and a strategic one (the vulnerability of systems).

jalons.ordre: The end of gold convertibility, creating a flexible monetary system founded on trust in the dollar.
jalons.dette: The United States exports its inflation and has its deficits financed by the rest of the world; a stability debt for the countries of the periphery.

jalons.ordre: A map of our cognitive biases, revealing a predictable architecture of human irrationality.
jalons.dette: This knowledge becomes a tool of manipulation (the nudge), displacing the disorder of our errors into a voluntary servitude to “choice architectures.”

jalons.titre: Bourdieu—the order of taste, the taste for order
jalons.ordre: The mechanisms of “distinction” unveiled, where taste serves as a class marker.
jalons.dette: Sociological lucidity itself becomes cultural capital, creating a new form of distinction through the critique of distinction.

jalons.titre: Neoliberalism—a whiff of dollar in the air
jalons.ordre: Monetary stability, market discipline, the liberation of capital flows.
jalons.dette: Disorder is displaced onto the social (mass unemployment, inequalities), the ecological (deregulation), and the political (loss of sovereignty).

jalons.ordre: Planetary connection, decentralized access to information.
jalons.dette: Cognitive fragmentation (overload), mass surveillance; the order of connection displaces disorder onto attention and privacy.

jalons.titre: The USSR—the empire that killed itself trying to cure itself
jalons.ordre: The end of the Cold War, the liberation of the nations held captive by the Soviet empire.
jalons.dette: Post-collapse economic and social chaos (shock therapy); political disorder displaced into regional conflicts and the rise of a revanchist Russian nationalism.

jalons.ordre: Knowledge of thousands of other worlds, radically decentering our place in the universe.
jalons.dette: The financial and energy cost of observation; an orbital debt (space debris); the Fermi paradox sharpens, creating existential disorder.

jalons.titre: Cerebral flux—lost abysses vs. captive surface
jalons.ordre: An attention economy that optimizes the capture of streams of consciousness.
jalons.dette: A collective mental desiccation, the loss of deep concentration; the cognitive debt is paid in fatigue and superficiality.

jalons.ordre: A human power become geological force, capable of shaping the planet.
jalons.dette: The debt is total: climatic, ecological, biospheric; the industrial order displaces disorder onto the whole Earth system, threatening its own survival.

jalons.ordre: A global security apparatus to forestall the terrorist threat.
jalons.dette: Civil liberties eroded, endless wars, moral authority lost; the promised security is paid for with generalized insecurity.

jalons.titre: The financial crisis—glass cathedral, cracked faith
jalons.ordre: The world financial system rescued by massive intervention from States and central banks.
jalons.dette: The socialization of private losses is paid for in public debt and austerity for entire populations; trust in the elites is lastingly broken.

jalons.ordre: A decentralized network of trust, with no intermediaries, founded on an algorithmic rule.
jalons.dette: The energy debt of “proof of work”; extreme volatility; trust is displaced from the political onto a code whose governance remains contested.

jalons.ordre: Surgical precision in genome editing, the promise of cures.
jalons.dette: An ethical debt (eugenics 2.0), a social one (biological inequalities), and an ecological one (gene drives); normative chaos displaced onto future generations.

jalons.titre: Algorithms—predicting without seeing, governing without a name
jalons.ordre: Prediction and optimization of behavior at scale.
jalons.dette: Algorithmic servitude, opaque decisions, the past petrified in predictive models; freedom becomes the capacity to deviate from the computed trajectory.

jalons.titre: The Paris Agreement—the soft in the hard
jalons.ordre: Diplomatic unanimity, a universal procedural framework for climate action.
jalons.dette: Procedural order displaces physical disorder (real emissions) onto the future and onto the global South; the climate debt keeps growing.

jalons.titre: The GDPR—the rights of the powerless
jalons.ordre: A legal framework for the protection of personal data, creating rights for citizens.
jalons.dette: A cognitive debt for users (consent fatigue) and a bureaucratic one for small and medium-sized firms; the formal order validates an architecture of extraction.

jalons.ordre: Health protection through social control (lockdowns, health passes).
jalons.dette: Economic disorder (public debt), social disorder (inequalities), psychic disorder (mental health), and educational disorder (learning losses), offloaded wholesale.

jalons.ordre: The production of language and images automated, productivity gained.
jalons.dette: A verification debt (hallucinations), a social debt (jobs replaced), and a cognitive debt (judgment atrophied); the plundering of creative corpora.

jalons.titre: The State without a people, the people without a State
jalons.ordre: The order of global financial markets, liquidity and efficiency of capital flows.
jalons.dette: Democratic States lose sovereignty; disorder is displaced onto peoples (austerity, precarity) to guarantee the stability of assets.
